baseline_exempt_reason: The QHM cap log lines already exist; this change is proven by a post-deploy QHM buy decision whose room reflects K x equity minus total notional minus the unused Swing reserve (re-derivable from the logged equity, positions and swing_breakout.json), or by the new 'QHM overnight room unavailable' fail-closed line.
expected_rate: Every QHM dip-add / tranche evaluation (RTH, per cycle when a hold is eligible)
